tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Finds products in the store catalog. Use when browsing available merchandise, comparing starting prices, or looking up items by title or brand.

query.description: Product name, brand, or search phrase as the user stated it

max_price.description: Optional maximum price filter in USD

tools.name: get_product_specs
tools.description: Retrieves detailed technical specifications and hardware configuration data for a catalog item. Use when checking physical dimensions, electrical ratings, or manufacturer hardware details.

tools.name: check_warehouse_stock
tools.description: Checks real-time fulfillment inventory and local store availability for a variant. Use when verifying stock counts, restock dates, or pickup readiness.

postal_code.description: Optional postal code to check nearby pickup availability

tools.name: list_product_reviews
tools.description: Lists customer-submitted reviews and feedback for a catalog product. Use when the user asks what buyers say about real-world quality, defects, or usability.

tools.name: update_cart_items
tools.description: Modifies the active shopping cart contents. Use when the user wants to add product variants to their cart, change how many they are buying, or remove selections.

items.description: List of variant SKU quantities to set in the cart

tools.name: reserve_store_pickup
tools.description: Places a temporary local pickup hold on an in-stock item. Use when the user wants to reserve available inventory for in-store collection.

warehouse_bin_id.description: Fulfillment bin allocation identifier for the item

pickup_contact_name.description: Full name of the person collecting the order

tools.name: list_customer_orders
tools.description: Lists orders placed on the customer's account. Use when browsing order history or looking up an order by date or fulfillment stage.

tools.name: get_shipment_tracking
tools.description: Fetches carrier logistics and package delivery details for an order. Use when checking package progress, delivery confirmation, or transit handling.

tools.name: get_order_invoice
tools.description: Retrieves the billing receipt and itemized fulfillment record for an order. Use when inspecting charges, tax breakdowns, or purchased unit records.

tools.name: initiate_return_label
tools.description: Opens the return shipping wizard to generate a prepaid carrier label for a delivered package. Use when the user wants to send an order back to the warehouse.

return_eligibility_token.description: Return authorization token for the fulfilled order item

tools.name: submit_refund_request
tools.description: Submits a financial refund payout back to the customer's payment method. Use when issuing a monetary credit for an eligible order.

payment_ledger_token.description: Settlement ledger token authorizing the refund payout

refund_amount_usd.description: Dollar amount in USD to refund

tools.name: initiate_warranty_repair
tools.description: Opens the manufacturer repair claim workflow for a malfunctioning hardware unit. Use when the user reports a hardware defect and wants warranty service.

serial_number.description: Hardware serial number of the defective unit

sku_code.description: Variant SKU code of the defective unit

issue_summary.description: Brief description of the hardware fault reported by the user

tools.name: get_user_preferences
tools.description: Retrieves the signed-in user's saved personal preferences and default profile settings. Use when personalizing searches or pre-filling actions with the user's usual defaults.

tools.name: get_loyalty_benefits
tools.description: Retrieves the customer's rewards program tier, point balance, and active membership perks. Use when checking reward entitlements, upgrade certificates, or member vouchers.

tools.name: get_corporate_policy
tools.description: Retrieves the organization's employee procurement rules, travel caps, and billing identifiers. Use when checking company expense limits, compliance rules, or department billing codes.

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Searches available commercial flights between two airports for a travel date. Use when looking up flight schedules, seat availability, or airfare options.

origin_iata.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the departure city (e.g. SFO)

destination_iata.description: 3-letter IATA airport code for the arrival city (e.g. JFK)

departure_date.description: Outbound travel date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

max_fare_usd.description: Optional maximum ticket price in USD

tools.name: initiate_flight_booking
tools.description: Opens the flight reservation checkout flow for a selected itinerary. Use when the user wants to book a specific flight with their billing or voucher details.

departure_date.description: Scheduled departure date formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

cost_center_code.description: Optional department cost center code for corporate billing

companion_voucher_code.description: Optional companion airfare voucher code to apply
